content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, and resubmission or patient billing would not cure the authorization denial or create valid patient liability. With the payer path exhausted and no secondary payer or collectible contractual patient share established, the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
